Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_record_found VARCHAR2(1);
 cursor c1 is
 select distinct u.inter_code x, inter_desc y,
 decode(inter_type, 'N', 'NFT', 'H', 'HOLD') z
 from valid_interdictions_lab v, unit_interdictions u
 where u.inter_code = v.inter_code
 and u.source_test_id = :control_mode
 and u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
 and exists (select *
 from units us
 where drive_id = :drive_id
 and us.coll_date = u.coll_date
 and us.chapter_id = u.chapter_id
 and us.unit_id = u.unit_id)
 order by 3,1;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :dummy_var := :drive_id;
 go_block('interdictions');
 temp_record_found := 'N';
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 temp_record_found := 'Y';
 :s_inter_code := c1_rec.x;
 :s_inter_desc := c1_rec.y;
 :s_inter_type := c1_rec.z;
 down;
 end loop;
 if temp_record_found = 'N'
 then
 message('Drive has no interdictions');
 GO_ITEM('batch_id');
 else
 clear_record;
 go_record('1');
 GO_ITEM('s_del_flag');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 tmp_inter_code VARCHAR2(4);
 tmp_desc VARCHAR2(1);
 rec_count number := 0;
 indx number;
begin
 last_record;
 rec_count := to_number(:system.cursor_record);
 first_record;
 for indx in 1..rec_count loop
 GO_ITEM('s_del_flag');
 tmp_desc := :system.cursor_value;
 if tmp_desc = 'X'
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_inter_code');
 tmp_inter_code := :system.cursor_value;
 if :control_mode = 'DRIVE'
 then
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions a
 where inter_code = tmp_inter_code
 and a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select *
 from units u
 where drive_id = :drive_id
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.coll_date = a.coll_date
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :control_mode = 'BATCH'
 then
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions a
 where inter_code = tmp_inter_code
 and a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select *
 from units u
 where batch_id = :batch_id
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.coll_date = a.coll_date
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :control_mode = 'LOT'
 then
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions a
 where inter_code = tmp_inter_code
 and a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select *
 from units u
 where lot_number = :lot_number
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.coll_date = a.coll_date
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :control_mode = 'COLL DATE'
 then
 if tmp_inter_code = 'QCRE'
 then
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions a
 where inter_code = tmp_inter_code
 and a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and a.source_test_id = :control_mode
 and exists (select *
 from units u
 where coll_date = :collect_date
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id)
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from utrs u
 where u.coll_date = :collect_date
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id
 and u.test_id = 'HIV1AG'
 and u.result_status_1 is null)
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from unit_test_base u
 where u.coll_date = :collect_date
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id
 and u.test_id = 'HIV1AG'
 and u.result_status_1 is null)
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from utrs u, utrs_audit ua, contract_tests c
 where u.coll_date = :collect_date
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id
 and c.contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 and c.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and c.test_id = u.test_id
 and c.stop_label_flag = 'Y'
 and sysdate between c.eff_date
 and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate)
 and u.test_id != 'HIV1AG'
 and u.audit_key = ua.audit_key
 and ua.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and ua.audit_insert_dats >
 (select nvl(min(label_dats),sysdate)
 from components
 where coll_date = :collect_date
 and unit_id = a.unit_id
 and chapter_id = a.chapter_id
 and system_label_decision != '39'
 and reject_reason_code is null))
 and not exists (select 'x'
 from unit_test_base u,
 unit_test_base_audit ua,
 contract_tests c
 where u.coll_date = :collect_date
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id
 and c.contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 and c.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and c.test_id = u.test_id
 and c.stop_label_flag = 'Y'
 and sysdate between c.eff_date
 and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate)
 and u.test_id != 'HIV1AG'
 and u.audit_key = ua.audit_key
 and ua.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and ua.audit_insert_dats >
 (select nvl(min(label_dats),sysdate)
 from components
 where coll_date = :collect_date
 and unit_id = a.unit_id
 and chapter_id = a.chapter_id
 and system_label_decision != '39'
 and reject_reason_code is null));
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions a
 where inter_code = tmp_inter_code
 and a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select *
 from units u
 where coll_date = :collect_date
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 down;
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_success
 then
 show_error('8010');
 else
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
end;
